Package dev.relism.flash.testing

Class FlashRequest

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.testing.FlashRequest
public final class FlashRequest extends Object
A request being built against a FlashTest server. The HTTP verb is terminal — it sends the request and hands back a FlashResponse: 

 app.request()
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    .json("{\"name\":\"bob\"}")
    .post("/api/users")
    .expectStatus(201);
For a bodyless GET or DELETE, FlashTest.get(java.lang.String) and FlashTest.delete(java.lang.String) skip the builder entirely.
